title: ABBA Workspace and Artifact Intelligence
rules: Artifact identity is distinct from artifact activity.
Canonical and historical surfaces remain distinguishable.
Duplicate content does not imply duplicate semantic identity.
Historical provenance must be preserved during migration.
Destructive deletion is not an autonomous default.
Migrations require fingerprint and lineage verification.
Recovery preserves the current state before reconstructing or restoring.
Archive is preferred to deletion when continuity matters.
